dossiers.thesis_summary: Definitive SPA (Feb 5, 2026) to sell Dingdong's China business to Meituan's Two Hearts unit for US$717M cash plus a right to sweep up to US$280M of BVI cash pre-close; shareholder approval done (AGM Mar 27); sole substantive open gate is SAMR anti-monopoly clearance. Company has committed (Feb 10 6-K) to return not less than 90% of post-close cash via buybacks/dividends — roughly $3.9/ADS returned against a $1.975 tape, with total post-close cash ~$4.3/ADS on 216.6M ADS. SPA carries a 12-month long-stop (~Feb 5, 2027, extendable) and a US$75M buyer break fee if antitrust clearance fails despite company cooperation. Deal verified unfired: Q1 6-K (May 22) states verbatim the transaction has not been completed; no clearance/closing announcement through Jul 6, 2026.
dossiers.kill_risk: Two-part residual: (1) SAMR review of dominant instant-retail player Meituan absorbing the #1 fresh-grocery e-tailer runs long or attaches conditions, pushing past the Feb-2027 long-stop where the deal becomes terminable (the $75M break fee ≈ only $0.35/ADS consolation); (2) the >=90% capital return is a stated INTENTION, not a binding covenant — terms are set post-close by a founder-controlled dual-class board, so even on a clean close the cash could be returned slowly/partially and the stock re-rate to a holdco-discount rather than the ~$3.9 cash value. Market pricing at $1.975 (below even consolidated net cash of $2.15/ADS) says the tape already charges for both.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Stock-for-stock Reverse Morris Trust in which Gentherm ACQUIRES Modine's Performance Technologies (SpinCo): THRM issues new shares equal to 40% of the pro forma fully diluted count to former SpinCo holders; existing THRM holders retain 60% and receive NO cash and NO fixed consideration — there is no spread to clip. The live pending event is deal close itself, guided Q4 CY2026 (special-meeting date still blank in the July 2, 2026 S-4; Outside Date 2027-03-31, extendable to 2027-06-30 for regulatory only). HSR antitrust was already cleared via early termination 2026-03-26; remaining gates are the Gentherm shareholder vote (Share Issuance + Charter Amendment), the IRS private-letter ruling, and consummation of the Separation/Distribution with SpinCo financing (Gentherm's own $550M revolver was refinanced 2026-06-29). Upside is a post-close re-rating on pro forma ~$2.6B revenue / ~$322M EBITDA (incl. $25M synergies), not an event-clipped convergence.
dossiers.kill_risk: Even if the merger closes on schedule, THRM common captures no contractual value at close — the entire payoff is a market re-rating of a bulked-up, lower-margin cyclical auto supplier, and at the live tape (~$33.91) the pro forma company already trades at ~6.8x gross EV/EBITDA on the $322M synergy-inclusive guide, roughly THRM's own standalone multiple — i.e., the re-rating is substantially priced. Residuals: (1) exchange-ratio adjustment risk — if the IRS ruling's Overlap Shareholder counting falls short of the ~50.5% Section 355(e) threshold, the ratio adjusts up toward 50.5% for SpinCo holders (economically offset by design via reduced SpinCo Cash Distribution / potential Gentherm Special Dividend, but a dilution-optics overhang); (2) the spent HSR clearance respawns if close slips past ~2027-03-26 (new filing required 12 months after early termination); (3) no floor — downside is the standalone cyclical trading range (52-wk low $27), market-dependent, with $470.7M pro forma debt post-close.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Idiosyncratic single-agency FDA binary. Aug 25, 2026 PDUFA target action date on Jazz's Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma sBLA — Priority Review, Breakthrough Therapy, Real-Time Oncology Review, pivotal HERIZON-GEA-01 positive (PFS 12.4 vs 8.1 mo, HR ~0.63, P<.0001). US GEA approval triggers a contractual, still-unpaid $250M milestone from Jazz to Zymeworks (~$3.40/sh on ~73.6M sh) plus royalty re-rating. Confirmed unfired at 2026-07-06 (50 days out), no CRL, no slip.
dossiers.kill_risk: Single FDA binary and it is the drug's FIRST-EVER GEA (new tumor type, NOT a label expansion — Ziihera's only prior US approval is 2L biliary tract cancer, Nov 2024). A CRL / RTOR pushback / label-restriction tail survives despite the strong Phase 3 + Breakthrough. On a CRL the $250M milestone is delayed (not lost), but the ~$19 floor is softer than a fortress-cash read: the approved-royalty leg it leans on is encumbered by a $250M Royalty Pharma royalty-backed note (executed 3/2/26, non-recourse, repaid from ~30% of worldwide Ziihera royalties). Added overlay: ZYME committed ~$929M cash + CVR to acquire Theravance (closing 2H26), so ZYME's own balance sheet is a moving target through the FDA window.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Two-stage Benelux self-restructuring against a chronic ~60% holdco discount: (1) binding, EC-cleared (unconditional, 25-Jun-2026) buy-in of Vodafone's 50% of VodafoneZiggo for EUR 1.0B cash + 10% of new Ziggo Group (VodafoneZiggo+Telenet), close guided July 2026, UNFIRED as of 07-06; (2) Ziggo Group Euronext-Amsterdam listing with ~90% distributed to Liberty Global holders, guided 'in 2027' (H2-2027 color on the 1-May call), leadership installed Sep 1 to prep it. The spin delivers Ziggo equity (~$12-14/sh gross by deal-implied math) directly into holders' hands, bypassing the holdco discount, with VMO2 50% + a $3.4B-FMV Liberty Growth book (alone ~93% of the $3.67B cap) left in the stub. Spin leg is voluntary and vote/window-contingent — a stage-in special situation, not a closed spread.
dossiers.kill_risk: The spin/listing is voluntary — subject to a not-yet-scheduled shareholder vote (6/23 AGM was routine only: directors/auditors/say-on-pay), SEC registration, and an open 2027 market window for a ~5x-levered Benelux telco (de-leverage roadmap only reaches ~4.5x by 2028). Nothing contractually compels it: Vodafone's remedy if no spin within 18 months of close is a right to sell its 10% to a third party — pressure, not compulsion. A weak listing tape pushes the event into 2028 with dead money at the holdco discount, and even on completion the retained stub (VMO2 + Growth) can keep trading at a deep discount, capping realized value well below $18. Floor $9.5 is a discount-persistence mark, not a cash backstop.
